fit_note: Generalist manager/worker routes target descriptions to visual, OCR and structural grounding experts.
Induces verified executable program skills from the agent's own episodes and adds them to the action space.
Self-proposed exploration distils practised trajectories into tested Playwright APIs reused by later agents.
Mid-trains the planner on non-GUI reasoning data before trajectory SFT; no reasoning-annotation synthesis.
Critique module judges each new state and triggers a multi-step rollback to a chosen earlier state.
Converts web tutorials into steps and has UI-TARS write thought plus action for each, then SFTs.
Parses human demonstrations into knowledge, retrieves the most relevant ones into the executor's context.
Visual diffusion world model predicts each candidate's next screen; an LLM selects the best action.
Teacher-generated spatial reasoning kept only if action correct, then RL with sub-goal and error-recovery rewards.
